person_note: The controlling narration is third person, rotating among numerous limited focal characters and sometimes widening into omniscient strategic commentary. The sustained interior passages q02748 and q02749, together with q02729, q02735, and q02736, expose that external narrating position. First-person and second-person forms in the sample are confined to speech, embedded quotation, or generic statements; notably, research shows that q02747 is dialogue despite its upstream event bucket. The authorized opening and whole-book structural descriptions independently agree, and targeted searches found no epistolary frame or sustained first- or second-person section. The publisher excerpt alone covers only the opening, but the interior quote evidence and multiple whole-book descriptions remove the principal scope uncertainty.
